Bug_Title: DMI: Collections should not contain themselves (DMI_COLLECTIONS_SHOULD_NOT_CONTAIN_THEMSELVES)
Bug_Details:
This call to a generic collection's method would only make sense if a collection contained
itself (e.g., if s.contains(s) were true). This is unlikely to be true and would cause
problems if it were true (such as the computation of the hash code resulting in infinite recursion).
It is likely that the wrong value is being passed as a parameter.
     s.contains(s)
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in line 6 of the code. The collection is checking if it contains itself, which is unlikely and could lead to problems like infinite recursion when calculating the hash code.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case triggered the bug by adding the buggyList to itself, which is not allowed as per the bug rule. This caused the buggy condition list.contains(list) to return true, resulting in the test case failure.
